name: Bad Witch and the Dark Magic Temptations
source:
Here's the question: What if Hermione Granger, the brightest witch of her age, were to be tempted by the dark arts? What if she were confronted with knowledge that challenged her very beliefs? The answer, as you will discover, reveals what it costs to hold the true power. 

[From [url=https://strange-girl-studios.itch.io/bad-witch-dark-magic-temptations]itch.io[/url]]
